newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine credit growth slows to 36 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Philippine credit growth slows to 36 pct in March.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Friday credit growth in the domestic banking industry slowed to 36.0 percent in March from 43.6 percent in the same period last year.
Central Bank deputy governor Edgardo Zialcita said the growth slowdown should allay fears of an overheating economy arising from rapid growth since 1992.
Private sector credit growth decelerated to 36.6 percent in March 1997 compared with 50.1 percent in March 1996 and 47.7 percent in January this year.
The manufacturing sector was still the biggest recipient of domestic credits, accounting for about a third of the total outstanding loans, Zialcita said.
